Custom Packaging MOQ Guide: How 500 PCS Factory Orders Work

Written by Lisa Wu, Sales Manager & Packaging Project AdvisorPublished July 24, 2026Reviewed August 13, 2026

Lisa coordinates B2B packaging specifications, quotations, sampling and production communication with the BestPackFactory team.

A practical MOQ guide for B2B buyers sourcing custom boxes, bags, labels, bottles and flexible packaging from a China packaging manufacturer.

Quick Answer

MOQ 500 PCS means the factory can open a custom production order for one confirmed size, material and artwork. It is suitable for first commercial launches, private label trials and seasonal campaigns, but buyers should still prepare accurate specifications to avoid sample changes and hidden cost.

What MOQ really means

MOQ is not only a sales rule. It is tied to material purchasing, machine setup, printing preparation, die-cutting and QC. Even a small custom order needs a confirmed material structure and artwork before production can be scheduled.

When 500 PCS makes sense

A 500 PCS custom packaging order works well for market testing, influencer kits, DTC launch batches, retail pilot programs and trade show packaging. It is not always the cheapest unit cost, but it gives buyers factory-direct customization without committing to excessive inventory.

How to reduce MOQ risk

Approve a physical sample, keep the first structure simple, avoid too many finish combinations and order realistic quantity tiers. Buyers can also start with one hero SKU and add more variants after sales data is clearer.

How to compare suppliers

Compare what is included in MOQ: dieline support, sample cost, color proofing, export carton packing, QC photos and shipping advice. A lower MOQ is not helpful if specifications are vague or communication is slow.

Procurement Checklist

  1. Confirm whether MOQ applies per size, per artwork or per material.
  2. Ask if several designs can share one structure.
  3. Request a quantity ladder for 500, 1,000 and 3,000 PCS.
  4. Clarify sample fee, sample time and bulk production time.
  5. Check whether shipping carton size is included in the quote.

Verification method and acceptance evidence

Method for Custom Packaging MOQ Guide: How 500 PCS Factory Orders Work: Record the approved sample revision, packed condition, lot size, inspection level, defect classes, acceptance limit, conditioning, equipment and pass/fail rule before inspection.

  • ISO 2859-1:2026 defines AQL-indexed sampling schemes and acceptance or rejection rules for lot-by-lot inspection.
  • ASTM D5276-19(2023) covers free-fall drop testing of loaded boxes, cylindrical containers, bags and sacks as packed systems.

Evidence limit: These standards define repeatable methods, not a passing result for a BestPackFactory order. Release decisions require a project-specific inspection or test report tied to the approved sample and production lot.

FAQ

Is MOQ 500 PCS per design?

In most custom packaging projects it is per size and artwork. Ask before combining SKUs.

Can I order below 500 PCS?

For fully custom production, 500 PCS is the normal starting point. For samples or limited tests, ask sales for the available options.

Does MOQ include free dieline support?

BestPackFactory can provide dieline support after size and structure are confirmed.

How do I get a better unit price?

Request price tiers and simplify materials, finish and structure for the first order.

What the Spec Means for Buyers

MOQ in B2B packaging is defined per production item, not per order: 500 PCS per confirmed size, material, artwork and finish. That means a brand can order multiple SKUs at 500 each without a higher total threshold. Standard structures hit MOQ at stable cost; premium finishes (soft-touch, hot foil, embossing) and rigid boxes scale in cost, not MOQ. Gates: die-cut ±1.5 mm, color ΔE ≤ 3.0, AQL 2.5. Sampling 5–7 working days, production 2–4 weeks.

Frequently Asked Questions

Does MOQ apply per SKU?

Yes — MOQ 500 PCS applies per confirmed size, material, artwork and finish, so multi-SKU orders are feasible.

Do premium finishes change the MOQ?

No — finishes change unit cost, not the 500 PCS baseline.
